shellCommands.command: git status && git log --oneline | head && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -200
cat index.html src/*.tsx src/*.ts vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; echo ---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls; ls build/esm | head -80; echo ---; cat build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -rl "ThemeProvider" build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -20

cat build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts; ls build/esm/components/theme/; cat build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts; cat build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js | head -80; echo ---; grep -n "theme\|Theme" README.md | head -40

cat build/esm/components/theme/useThemeType.js build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.js build/esm/components/theme/useThemeSettings.js build/esm/components/theme/dom-helpers.js build/esm/components/theme/constants.js build/esm/components/theme/getThemeType.js; echo ---; sed -n 36,100p README.md; echo ---; ls build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && cat components/controls/Switch/Switch.d.ts 2>/dev/null || find . -name "Switch*.d.ts" | head; echo ---; find . -path "*SegmentedRadioGroup*" -name "*.d.ts" | head; echo ---; cat deprecated.d.ts | head -60; echo ---; cat legacy.d.ts | head -40; echo ---; cat components/theme/ThemeSettingsContext.d.ts components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts components/theme/useThemeContext.d.ts

cat components/Switch/Switch.d.ts; echo ---; cat components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts; echo ---; cat components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts; echo ---; cat components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -80; echo ---; ls components/legacy | head -50

cat components/types.d.ts | head -80; echo ---; cat components/Switch/Switch.js | head -40; echo; cat components/theme/ThemeContext.js; echo ---; cat components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.js | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -o "g-root[^{]*{[^}]*}" styles/styles.css | head -20; echo ---; cat build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -40; echo ---; grep -n "variant\|export" build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -20; echo ---; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/.bin | grep -E "^(tsc|vite|vitest)$"; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls styles; grep -rho "\.g-root[^{]*{[^}]*}" styles/*.css | head -10; echo ---; grep -rn "background" styles/styles.css 2>/dev/null | head; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; echo done
sed -n 1,12p styles/styles.css; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --version && npx vite --version && (npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15)
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -20
ls node_modules | grep -iE "^(jsdom|happy-dom|playwright|puppeteer|@testing-library)$"; ls node_modules/@testing-library 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/playwright-core 2>/dev/null | head -2; echo done
rm -rf dist && git status --short && git diff --stat
